_note: Tag Teams section (assets/teams.js). The teams themselves are built in the app from the Goddess of Stardom and NEW BLOOD Tag Team title histories (assets/lineage/goddess.json and newblood.json, or the daily file's copies), so a new champion team appears without editing this file. This file only adds what the histories don't say. eraStarts = the first day of eras 2 to 5 (era 1 is everything before); a team's era is the era of its first title win. factionNames = team names in the histories that are really a faction's name: such pairs are shown as their two names with the faction underneath. spell = another spelling of a name, searched second (only when the first search finds no videos) and used in the video index side check. The first search uses the same name the Wrestler filter uses (factions.json "search"), as "A Tag Team B". extra = teams that never held these titles: {name, members: [a, b], since: 'YYYY-MM-DD', faction}.
